name: Gaol of Khazarad, Hallway
desc1: This narrow stone passage is short and plain, ending in a small square
desc2: room. Iron bars in the eastern wall of this room block off a large
desc3: jail cell, where brawlers and the rare prisoner are thrown. Although
desc4: the dwarves can be merciless to their foes, prisoners who have not
desc5: committed murder are often treated well. Other more mortal foes,
desc6: however, rarely live to see the inside of this cell...
